evidence.title: Turno A Log
evidence.claim: In 2006, plant personnel were unaware of the reason for storing pails upside down for 24 hours.
evidence.quote: EF-210 secchi capovolti 24 ore come da ricetta - chiedere a Gastaldi il perché. Nessuno in reparto lo sa.

evidence.title: CUSTOMER CLAIM CL-2004-003
evidence.claim: A customer reported pinholes and craters on an EF-210 floor in March 2004, leading to a claim in May 2004.
evidence.quote: Complaint: pinholes and craters across the floor; recoating required.

evidence.title: Upside-down pails
evidence.claim: In 2014, staff speculated the step was for leak checking or keeping gaskets wet, but noted no written justification exists.
evidence.quote: neither reason is written anywhere. 'FT' in Rev 6 could be a person's initials.

verdict.process_name: EF-210 epoxy floor coating, Part A
verdict.instruction: Store filled pails upside down for 24 h before palletising.
verdict.reason: No documented reason for the step exists in the archive. Personnel in 2006 were unaware of the purpose (E3), and staff in 2014 confirmed no written justification exists, noting that theories regarding leak checking or gaskets were merely speculation (E5).

counter_evidence.resolution: There is no documented link between the 2004 claim and the implementation of the upside-down storage step.
